projects.title: Kinex - Enterprise Task & Project Management Platform

projects.title: NuComply - Regulatory Compliance RAG Automation

projects.title: Road Light Management System
projects.description: Deployed a centralized web platform for Chittagong City Corporation enabling real-time monitoring and remote control of individual and grouped street lights. Reduced manual inspection workload and improved fault response time through an intuitive dashboard interface.

projects.title: London Borough Real Estate Platform (LBREP) - Backend
projects.description: A Django-based real estate listing platform with geographic information system (GIS) capabilities. Features comprehensive property listings, user management, and spatial query functionality for browsing properties with spatial data and points of interest.
